title: Totem of Gaga (Abracadabra)
description: Totem of Gaga with a second audio!
body:
Comes with a new audio when the totem is activated. 

**Ignore incompatible, will work with _all_ versions.**

I couldn't decide between two audios. The second version is located [here](https://modrinth.com/project/totem-of-gaga-v1)
